description: A parameter name string whose template gives a name is an error
notes: The README doesn't say how parameter names are read, and a JSON string is a template in most places, so a template giving the name would be another reading. hashicorp/hcl reads each name with hcl.ExprAsKeyword (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), for which the JSON syntax parses the string as a native syntax traversal ((*expression).AsTraversal in json/structure.go), where a template sequence is an error.
